title: GitHub availability report: September 2026
author: Jakub Oleksy
description: In September, we experienced two incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services. The post GitHub availability report: September 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Our last update covered content through August. We did not publish another in September while other public content addressed the August 17 outage.
takeaways: The short version of August and September : we reduced shared-database pressure, added overload controls, created headroom for GitHub Actions, expanded failure containment for pull requests, and moved more production workloads to Azure.
A production overload control now lets responders protect higher-priority API and web workflows by rejecting lower-priority requests before broader saturation.
By October 7, 120 of 160 production services were deployed in Central US, and 13 of 51 primary MySQL databases had moved.
